flyers-as.definition: a word used to compare two things, like 'as big as'
flyers-as.definitionVi: từ dùng để so sánh, nghĩa là 'bằng như'
flyers-as.hint: Use 'as' with another 'as' to compare things: 'as tall as'.
flyers-as.fact: You often see 'as' twice in one sentence, like 'as fast as a cheetah'.

flyers-as-as.definition: used to say two things are the same in some way
flyers-as-as.definitionVi: cấu trúc so sánh bằng, nghĩa là 'bằng như'
flyers-as-as.hint: Try it: 'She is as tall as her brother.'
flyers-as-as.fact: This pattern helps you compare people, animals, or things easily.

flyers-astronaut.definition: a person who travels and works in space
flyers-astronaut.definitionVi: phi hành gia, người bay vào vũ trụ
flyers-astronaut.hint: Astronauts wear a special suit and helmet in space.
flyers-astronaut.fact: Astronauts float because there is very little gravity in space.

flyers-at-the-moment.definition: right now, at this exact time
flyers-at-the-moment.hint: Use it to say what is happening now: 'I am reading at the moment.'
flyers-at-the-moment.fact: 'At the moment' is a handy phrase for talking about now in English.

flyers-autumn.definition: the season between summer and winter when leaves fall
flyers-autumn.definitionVi: mùa thu, mùa giữa hè và đông
flyers-autumn.hint: Leaves turn orange and brown in autumn.
flyers-autumn.fact: Autumn is also called 'fall' in American English.

flyers-away.definition: not in the usual place, or moving from a place
flyers-away.definitionVi: đi xa, không ở đây nữa
flyers-away.hint: Say 'run away' when someone leaves quickly.
flyers-away.fact: Birds fly away to warmer places in winter.

flyers-agree.definition: to think the same as someone else
flyers-agree.hint: Nod your head to show you agree.
flyers-agree.fact: Friends do not always agree, and that is okay!

flyers-air.definition: the gas all around us that we breathe
flyers-air.definitionVi: không khí, thứ ta hít thở
flyers-air.hint: You cannot see air, but you can feel the wind.
flyers-air.fact: Air is made mostly of a gas called nitrogen.

flyers-airport.definition: a place where planes take off and land
flyers-airport.definitionVi: sân bay, nơi máy bay cất và hạ cánh
flyers-airport.hint: You check in your bags before you get on a plane at the airport.
flyers-airport.fact: Some airports are so big that people travel between gates by train.

flyers-alone.definition: without any other person near you
flyers-alone.definitionVi: một mình, không có ai bên cạnh
flyers-alone.hint: Being alone for a little while can feel peaceful.
flyers-alone.fact: Some animals, like tigers, like to live alone.

flyers-already.definition: before now, or sooner than expected
flyers-already.hint: Say 'I have already finished' when a job is done early.
flyers-already.fact: 'Already' shows something happened faster than we thought!

flyers-also.definition: as well as something else already said
flyers-also.hint: Use 'also' to add more information: 'I like cats. I also like dogs.'
flyers-also.fact: 'Also', 'too', and 'as well' all mean almost the same thing.

flyers-amazing.hint: Say 'amazing' when something is much better than you expected.
flyers-amazing.fact: Fireworks and rainbows often make people say 'amazing!'

flyers-ambulance.definition: a vehicle that takes sick or hurt people to hospital
flyers-ambulance.hint: An ambulance has a loud siren and flashing lights.
flyers-ambulance.fact: Ambulances can drive fast through red lights in an emergency.

flyers-anywhere.definition: in, at, or to any place
flyers-anywhere.hint: Say 'anywhere' when the place does not matter: 'Sit anywhere you like.'
flyers-anywhere.fact: You use 'anywhere' mostly in questions and negative sentences.

flyers-appear.hint: A rainbow can appear after it rains.
flyers-appear.fact: Magicians often make things appear and disappear as a trick.

flyers-arrive.definition: to get to a place at the end of a journey
flyers-arrive.hint: You arrive at school after your journey there.
flyers-arrive.fact: Trains and planes have a special time when they should arrive.

flyers-art.definition: the subject where you draw, paint, and make things
flyers-art.hint: In art class you might paint a picture or make a model.
flyers-art.fact: Famous paintings are kept safe in places called art galleries.

flyers-artist.definition: a person who makes paintings or other art
flyers-artist.hint: An artist often uses a brush and paint.
flyers-artist.fact: Some artists paint pictures, and some make statues or music.

flyers-act.definition: to perform a part in a play or film
flyers-act.hint: Actors act on a stage or in front of a camera.
flyers-act.fact: Children can act in school plays too!

flyers-actor.definition: a person whose job is acting in films or plays
flyers-actor.hint: An actor learns lines and pretends to be someone else.
flyers-actor.fact: Actors sometimes wear costumes and make-up for their part.

flyers-actually.definition: used to say what is really true
flyers-actually.hint: Use 'actually' to correct something: 'Actually, it's blue, not green.'
flyers-actually.fact: 'Actually' helps you share a surprising true fact.

flyers-adventure.hint: Storybooks about pirates or explorers are full of adventure.
flyers-adventure.fact: Going somewhere new can feel like a small adventure.

flyers-after.definition: later than something, or next in time
flyers-after.hint: You have a snack after school.
flyers-after.fact: 'After' tells you the order things happen in.

flyers-ago.hint: Say 'two days ago' to talk about the past.
flyers-ago.fact: 'Ago' always comes after the amount of time, like 'a week ago'.

flyers-business.definition: work of buying, selling, or making things for money
flyers-business.hint: A shop is a small kind of business.
flyers-business.fact: Some people start their own business when they grow up.

flyers-businessman.definition: a man who works in business, buying or selling things
flyers-businessman.hint: A businessman often wears a suit and carries a briefcase.
flyers-businessman.fact: Businessmen and businesswomen help run shops and companies.

flyers-butter.definition: a soft yellow food made from milk
flyers-butter.hint: We spread butter on bread or toast.
flyers-butter.fact: Butter is made by shaking or churning cream.

flyers-butterfly.definition: a colourful insect with big, thin wings
flyers-butterfly.hint: A butterfly starts life as a caterpillar.
flyers-butterfly.fact: Butterflies taste with their feet, not their mouth!

flyers-by-myself.definition: alone, with no one helping you
flyers-by-myself.hint: Say 'I did it by myself' when you needed no help.
flyers-by-myself.fact: Doing something by myself can make you feel proud.

flyers-by-yourself.definition: alone, without anyone else helping you
flyers-by-yourself.definitionVi: tự bạn, một mình bạn (làm gì)
flyers-by-yourself.hint: A teacher might say, 'Try it by yourself first.'
flyers-by-yourself.fact: Learning to do things by yourself helps you grow up.

flyers-backpack.definition: a bag you carry on your back
flyers-backpack.hint: You carry your books to school in a backpack.
flyers-backpack.fact: Backpacks have two straps so you can carry them on both shoulders.

flyers-bandage.definition: a strip of cloth used to cover a cut
flyers-bandage.hint: A nurse puts a bandage on a hurt knee or arm.
flyers-bandage.fact: Bandages keep a wound clean while it heals.

flyers-bank.definition: a place where people keep their money safe
flyers-bank.hint: You can save your money in a bank.
flyers-bank.fact: Banks also help people borrow money to buy a house.

flyers-beetle.definition: a small insect with a hard, shiny back
flyers-beetle.hint: A beetle's hard wings protect its soft wings underneath.
flyers-beetle.fact: There are more kinds of beetles than any other animal on Earth.

flyers-before.definition: earlier than something, or first in time
flyers-before.hint: Wash your hands before you eat.

flyers-begin.hint: The lesson will begin when the bell rings.
flyers-begin.fact: 'Begin' and 'start' mean almost the same thing.

flyers-believe.definition: to feel sure that something is true
flyers-believe.hint: Say 'I believe you' when you trust what someone says.
flyers-believe.fact: Many children believe in magic when they are young.

flyers-belt.definition: a strip you wear around your waist
flyers-belt.hint: A belt keeps your trousers from falling down.
flyers-belt.fact: In karate, belts of different colours show your skill level.

flyers-bicycle.definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal
flyers-bicycle.hint: You need to balance carefully when you ride a bicycle.

flyers-bin.definition: a container where you put rubbish
flyers-bin.hint: Put your rubbish in the bin, not on the floor.
flyers-bin.fact: Some bins are for recycling paper, plastic, or glass.

flyers-biscuit.definition: a small, flat, baked sweet snack
flyers-biscuit.hint: You might dip a biscuit in milk or tea.
flyers-biscuit.fact: In the US, a similar snack is called a 'cookie'.

flyers-bit.definition: a small amount or small piece of something
flyers-bit.hint: Say 'a bit tired' to mean a little tired.
flyers-bit.fact: 'A bit' is a friendly way to say 'a little'.

flyers-bored.definition: feeling tired because there is nothing fun to do
flyers-bored.hint: Find a game or a book when you feel bored.
flyers-bored.fact: Being bored sometimes helps you think of fun new ideas.

flyers-borrow.definition: to take something and give it back later
flyers-borrow.hint: You can borrow books from the library.
flyers-borrow.fact: Always remember to return what you borrow!

flyers-bracelet.definition: a piece of jewellery worn around the wrist
flyers-bracelet.hint: A bracelet can be made of beads, metal, or string.
flyers-bracelet.fact: Friends sometimes make matching bracelets for each other.

flyers-bridge.definition: a structure built over a river or road
flyers-bridge.hint: A bridge helps you cross a river without getting wet.
flyers-bridge.fact: Some famous bridges, like Tower Bridge, can open in the middle.

flyers-broken.definition: damaged and in pieces, or not working
flyers-broken.hint: A broken toy needs to be fixed or thrown away.
flyers-broken.fact: If you drop a glass, it might get broken.

flyers-brush.definition: a tool with bristles for cleaning or hair
flyers-brush.hint: You use a brush to tidy your hair or paint a picture.
flyers-brush.fact: There are brushes for teeth, hair, paint, and even floors.

flyers-burn.definition: to damage something with fire or heat
flyers-burn.hint: Be careful — the oven can burn your fingers.
flyers-burn.fact: Fire fighters work hard to stop things from burning.

flyers-calendar.definition: a chart that shows the days, weeks, and months
flyers-calendar.hint: Look at the calendar to find out what day your birthday is.
flyers-calendar.fact: A calendar has 12 months and about 365 days.

flyers-camel.definition: a large desert animal with one or two humps
flyers-camel.hint: A camel's humps store fat, not water!
flyers-camel.fact: Camels can travel a long way in hot deserts without drinking.

flyers-camp.definition: to sleep outside in a tent
flyers-camp.hint: Families often camp near a lake or in the forest.
flyers-camp.fact: You can see many more stars at night when you camp outdoors.

flyers-card.definition: a small piece of stiff paper with a message or picture
flyers-card.hint: You send a card to say happy birthday.
flyers-card.fact: People collect special cards, like football or game cards.

flyers-cartoon.definition: a funny drawn film or picture
flyers-cartoon.hint: You watch cartoons on TV or online.
flyers-cartoon.fact: The first cartoons on film were made over 100 years ago.

flyers-castle.definition: a large old building built for a king or queen
flyers-castle.hint: Old castles often have tall towers and thick walls.
flyers-castle.fact: Many castles were built hundreds of years ago to keep people safe.

flyers-cave.definition: a large natural hole in a hill or under the ground
flyers-cave.hint: Bats and bears sometimes live in caves.
flyers-cave.fact: Some caves have beautiful rock shapes called stalactites.

flyers-century.definition: a period of one hundred years
flyers-century.hint: We live in the twenty-first century.
flyers-century.fact: A century is ten times longer than a decade.

flyers-cereal.definition: a breakfast food made from grain, eaten with milk
flyers-cereal.hint: Many children eat cereal with milk for breakfast.
flyers-cereal.fact: Cereal is often made from corn, wheat, oats, or rice.

flyers-channel.definition: a station you can watch on TV
flyers-channel.hint: You change the channel with the TV remote.
flyers-channel.fact: There are channels just for cartoons, sport, or nature shows.

flyers-chat.definition: to talk in a friendly, relaxed way
flyers-chat.hint: You can chat with friends at break time.
flyers-chat.fact: 'Chat' can also mean sending friendly messages online.

flyers-cheap.hint: A cheap toy does not cost many coins.

flyers-chemist-s.definition: a shop where you buy medicine
flyers-chemist-s.hint: You go to the chemist's shop to buy medicine or shampoo.
flyers-chemist-s.fact: A chemist's shop can also be called a pharmacy.

flyers-chess.definition: a board game for two players with pieces like kings
flyers-chess.hint: In chess, you try to trap the other player's king.
flyers-chess.fact: Chess is one of the oldest board games in the world.

flyers-chopsticks.definition: two thin sticks used for eating food
flyers-chopsticks.hint: People in many Asian countries eat rice with chopsticks.
flyers-chopsticks.fact: It takes practice to hold chopsticks correctly!

flyers-club.definition: a group of people who meet to share an interest
flyers-club.hint: You might join a football club or a book club.
flyers-club.fact: Clubs meet regularly so members can enjoy the same hobby together.

flyers-collect.definition: to gather things together over time
flyers-collect.hint: Some children collect stamps, coins, or stickers.
flyers-collect.fact: Collecting things is a popular and fun hobby.

flyers-college.definition: a school where older students study after secondary school
flyers-college.hint: You often go to college after you finish secondary school.
flyers-college.fact: At college, students can choose subjects they enjoy most.

flyers-comb.definition: a flat tool with teeth used to tidy hair
flyers-comb.hint: You use a comb to make your hair neat.
flyers-comb.fact: Combs have been used to tidy hair for thousands of years.

flyers-competition.definition: a game or contest where people try to win
flyers-competition.hint: You can win a prize in a school competition.
flyers-competition.fact: The Olympics is a huge sports competition held every four years.

flyers-concert.definition: a show where musicians play music for people
flyers-concert.hint: People clap and sing along at a concert.
flyers-concert.fact: Some concerts have thousands of people singing together.

flyers-conversation.definition: when two or more people talk together
flyers-conversation.hint: You take turns speaking during a conversation.
flyers-conversation.fact: Good conversations need good listening, too!

flyers-cooker.definition: a machine used to cook food in the kitchen
flyers-cooker.hint: You boil or fry food on top of the cooker.
flyers-cooker.fact: A cooker usually has hot rings on top and an oven inside.

flyers-cookie.hint: Cookies often have chocolate chips inside.
flyers-cookie.fact: In British English, a cookie is usually called a 'biscuit'.

flyers-corner.definition: the point where two lines or walls meet
flyers-corner.hint: The shop is on the corner of the street.

flyers-costume.definition: special clothes worn to look like someone else
flyers-costume.hint: Children wear costumes for parties or plays.
flyers-costume.fact: People wear fun costumes for Halloween or a fancy dress party.

flyers-ibility.definition: was able to do something in the past
flyers-ibility.definitionVi: đã có thể (làm gì đó trong quá khứ)
flyers-ibility.hint: Say 'I could swim when I was five' to talk about past ability.
flyers-ibility.fact: 'Could' is the past form of the word 'can'.

flyers-creature.definition: a living being, especially an animal
flyers-creature.hint: A dinosaur was a huge creature that lived long ago.
flyers-creature.fact: Storybooks are full of strange and magical creatures.

flyers-crown.definition: a special hat worn by a king or queen
flyers-crown.hint: A crown is often made of gold and jewels.
flyers-crown.fact: Kings and queens wear a crown at important ceremonies.

flyers-cushion.definition: a soft pillow used on a chair or sofa
flyers-cushion.hint: You put a cushion on the sofa to make it comfy.
flyers-cushion.fact: Cushions can be soft, colourful, and many shapes.

flyers-cut.definition: to use scissors or a knife to divide something
flyers-cut.hint: You cut paper with scissors in art class.
flyers-cut.fact: Be careful — sharp scissors can cut your finger too!

flyers-cycle.hint: Wear a helmet when you cycle to stay safe.
flyers-cycle.fact: Cycling is great exercise and does not pollute the air.

flyers-drum.definition: a musical instrument you hit to make a beat
flyers-drum.hint: You hit a drum with your hands or sticks.
flyers-drum.fact: Drums are one of the oldest instruments in the world.

flyers-dark.hint: Turn on a light when the room is dark.
flyers-dark.fact: The sky gets dark at night because the sun has set.

flyers-date.definition: a particular day, shown by the day, month and year
flyers-date.hint: Write today's date at the top of your worksheet.
flyers-date.fact: A date tells us exactly which day something happens.

flyers-dear.definition: loved, or used to start a friendly letter
flyers-dear.definitionVi: thân mến (dùng để mở đầu thư)
flyers-dear.hint: Letters often begin with 'Dear' and then the person's name.
flyers-dear.fact: 'Dear' shows you care about the person you are writing to.

flyers-decide.definition: to choose something after thinking about it
flyers-decide.hint: Take your time to decide which book to read.
flyers-decide.fact: It can be hard to decide between two favourite things!

flyers-deep.definition: going far down from the top or surface
flyers-deep.hint: The ocean is very deep in some places.
flyers-deep.fact: The deepest part of the ocean is deeper than Mount Everest is tall.

flyers-delicious.hint: Say 'delicious' when your food tastes really good.
flyers-delicious.fact: Your favourite meal probably tastes delicious to you!

flyers-desert.definition: a very dry, sandy place with little rain
flyers-desert.hint: Deserts are hot in the day and cold at night.
flyers-desert.fact: Camels are well suited to living in the desert.

flyers-design.definition: a drawing or plan showing how to make something
flyers-design.hint: You make a design before you build or draw something.
flyers-design.fact: Designers plan everything from clothes to buildings.

flyers-designer.definition: a person who plans how things will look
flyers-designer.hint: A designer might plan clothes, toys, or buildings.
flyers-designer.fact: Fashion designers create the clothes we wear.

flyers-diary.definition: a book where you write about your day
flyers-diary.hint: You can write your feelings and plans in a diary.
flyers-diary.fact: Some famous diaries have become books that people still read today.

flyers-dictionary.definition: a book that explains what words mean
flyers-dictionary.hint: Look up a new word in the dictionary to learn its meaning.
flyers-dictionary.fact: A big dictionary can have hundreds of thousands of words.

flyers-dinosaur.definition: a huge animal that lived millions of years ago
flyers-dinosaur.hint: You can see dinosaur bones in a museum.
flyers-dinosaur.fact: Dinosaurs disappeared about 66 million years ago.

flyers-disappear.definition: to stop being seen, or go away suddenly
flyers-disappear.hint: A magician can make a coin disappear.

flyers-eagle.definition: a large, strong bird that hunts other animals
flyers-eagle.hint: An eagle has sharp eyes to spot food from high up.
flyers-eagle.fact: Eagles can see much better than humans can.

flyers-early.definition: before the usual or expected time
flyers-early.hint: Get up early so you are not late for school.

flyers-east.definition: the direction where the sun rises
flyers-east.hint: The sun always rises in the east.
flyers-east.fact: A compass has four main directions: north, south, east, and west.

flyers-elbow.definition: the joint where your arm bends
flyers-elbow.hint: Bend your elbow to touch your shoulder.
flyers-elbow.fact: Your elbow lets your arm bend so you can reach things.

flyers-else.definition: different, or in addition to what has been said
flyers-else.hint: Ask 'What else do you need?' to find out more.
flyers-else.fact: 'Else' often follows question words like 'who' or 'what'.

flyers-empty.hint: An empty glass has no water in it.

flyers-engine.definition: the part of a vehicle that makes it move
flyers-engine.hint: A car's engine is usually at the front.
flyers-engine.fact: Engines can run on petrol, diesel, or electricity.

flyers-engineer.definition: a person who designs or builds machines and structures
flyers-engineer.hint: Engineers design bridges, machines, and computers.
flyers-engineer.fact: There are many kinds of engineers, like those who build planes.

flyers-enormous.definitionVi: khổng lồ, cực kỳ to lớn
flyers-enormous.hint: An enormous whale is much bigger than a car.

flyers-enough.hint: Ask 'Do we have enough?' before you start.
flyers-enough.fact: If you have enough, you don't need any more.

flyers-enter-a-competition.definition: to join a contest to try to win
flyers-enter-a-competition.hint: You can enter a competition at school or online.
flyers-enter-a-competition.fact: Entering a competition can be fun even if you don't win.

flyers-entrance.definition: the door or way into a place
flyers-entrance.hint: Wait at the entrance for your friends.

flyers-envelope.definition: a paper cover used to send a letter
flyers-envelope.hint: You put a letter inside an envelope before posting it.
flyers-envelope.fact: You stick a stamp on the envelope before you post it.

flyers-environment.definition: the natural world around us, like air, land, and water
flyers-environment.fact: Trees clean the air and help the environment.

flyers-ever.definition: at any time, in your whole life
flyers-ever.hint: Ask 'Have you ever seen a whale?'
flyers-ever.fact: 'Ever' is often used in questions about experiences.

flyers-everywhere.definition: in every place, or all around
flyers-everywhere.hint: Toys were everywhere after the party!
flyers-everywhere.fact: 'Everywhere' means there is no place it does not include.

flyers-excellent.hint: A teacher might say 'excellent work!' for a great answer.
flyers-excellent.fact: 'Excellent' is a stronger way of saying 'very good'.

flyers-excited.definition: feeling very happy about something that will happen
flyers-excited.hint: You feel excited before your birthday party.
flyers-excited.fact: Being excited can make your heart beat a little faster.

flyers-exit.definition: the door or way out of a place
flyers-exit.hint: Look for the exit sign to find the way out.

flyers-expensive.hint: A new bike can be quite expensive.

flyers-explain.definition: to tell someone something clearly so they understand
flyers-explain.hint: Ask your teacher to explain if you don't understand.
flyers-explain.fact: Explaining something well helps other people learn it too.

flyers-explore.definition: to travel and look around a new place
flyers-explore.hint: Explorers like to explore forests, caves, and oceans.
flyers-explore.fact: You can explore a new park or even your own garden.

flyers-extinct.hint: Dinosaurs are extinct — none are alive today.
flyers-extinct.fact: When an animal becomes extinct, it can never come back.

flyers-factory.definition: a building where things are made in large numbers
flyers-factory.hint: Toys and cars are often made in a factory.
flyers-factory.fact: Machines in factories can make thousands of things every day.

flyers-fall-over.definition: to lose your balance and drop to the ground
flyers-fall-over.hint: Be careful on ice so you don't fall over.
flyers-fall-over.fact: Babies fall over a lot while they learn to walk.

flyers-far.hint: Ask 'Is it far?' before you start walking.

flyers-fast.hint: A cheetah can run very fast.

flyers-feel.definition: to have a certain emotion or sensation
flyers-feel.hint: Say 'I feel happy' to share how you feel.
flyers-feel.fact: You can also feel things with your hands, like soft or rough.

flyers-festival.definition: a special day or time of celebration
flyers-festival.hint: There is music, food, and fun at a festival.
flyers-festival.fact: Different countries have their own special festivals to celebrate.

flyers-fetch.definition: to go and bring something back
flyers-fetch.hint: Dogs love to fetch a thrown ball.
flyers-fetch.fact: 'Fetch' is a fun game to play with a pet dog.

flyers-file.definition: a folder used to keep papers together
flyers-file.definitionVi: tệp hồ sơ, cặp đựng tài liệu
flyers-file.hint: Keep your worksheets tidy in a file.
flyers-file.fact: On a computer, a 'file' can also mean a document you save.

flyers-find-out.definition: to discover information you did not know
flyers-find-out.hint: Read a book to find out more about a topic.
flyers-find-out.fact: Scientists find out new things by testing their ideas.

flyers-finger.definition: one of the five parts at the end of your hand
flyers-finger.hint: Point with your finger to show something.
flyers-finger.fact: You have ten fingers, including your two thumbs.

flyers-finish.definition: to complete something or come to the end
flyers-finish.hint: Try to finish your homework before dinner.

flyers-fire.hint: Never play with fire — it can be dangerous.
flyers-fire.fact: Fire needs oxygen, heat, and fuel to keep burning.

flyers-fire-engine.definition: a large vehicle that carries fire fighters and water
flyers-fire-engine.hint: A fire engine is usually red with a loud siren.
flyers-fire-engine.fact: Fire engines carry long hoses and ladders to fight fires.

flyers-fire-fighter.definition: a person whose job is to put out fires
flyers-fire-fighter.hint: A fire fighter wears a helmet and special suit to stay safe.
flyers-fire-fighter.fact: Fire fighters also help rescue people and animals in danger.

flyers-fire-station.definition: a building where fire engines and fire fighters are based
flyers-fire-station.hint: Fire engines wait at the fire station until they are needed.
flyers-fire-station.fact: Fire fighters can leave the fire station in under a minute.

flyers-flag.definition: a piece of cloth with colours that represents a country
flyers-flag.hint: Every country has its own special flag.
flyers-flag.fact: Flags often use colours and symbols that mean something important.

flyers-flashlight.definition: a small light you carry and hold in your hand
flyers-flashlight.hint: Use a flashlight to see in the dark.
flyers-flashlight.fact: In British English, a flashlight is usually called a 'torch'.

flyers-flour.definition: a white powder made from grain, used for baking
flyers-flour.hint: You need flour to bake bread or a cake.
flyers-flour.fact: Flour is usually made by grinding wheat into a fine powder.

flyers-fog.definition: a thick cloud of mist close to the ground
flyers-fog.hint: It is hard to see far when there is fog.
flyers-fog.fact: Fog forms when warm, wet air cools down near the ground.

flyers-foggy.definition: covered with a thick, low cloud of fog
flyers-foggy.hint: Drive slowly and carefully on a foggy morning.
flyers-foggy.fact: On a foggy day, you cannot see very far ahead.

flyers-follow.definition: to go behind or after someone
flyers-follow.hint: Follow the teacher in a line to the playground.
flyers-follow.fact: Ducklings follow their mother wherever she swims.

flyers-forget.hint: Write a note so you don't forget your homework.

flyers-fork.definition: a tool with points, used for eating food
flyers-fork.hint: You hold food still with a fork while you cut it.
flyers-fork.fact: A fork usually has three or four sharp points called tines.

flyers-fridge.definition: a machine that keeps food cold
flyers-fridge.hint: Put the milk back in the fridge so it stays fresh.

flyers-friendly.definition: kind and pleasant to other people
flyers-friendly.hint: Smile and say hello to be friendly.
flyers-friendly.fact: A friendly dog often wags its tail.

flyers-frightening.hint: A loud thunderstorm can be frightening for some pets.
flyers-frightening.fact: Scary films are made to feel frightening on purpose.

flyers-front.definition: at the part that faces forward, or first in a line
flyers-front.hint: Sit at the front of the class to see the board better.

flyers-full.definition: holding as much as possible, with no space left
flyers-full.hint: Say 'I'm full' when you cannot eat any more.

flyers-fur.definition: the soft hair covering many animals' bodies
flyers-fur.hint: Cats and rabbits have soft fur.
flyers-fur.fact: Fur keeps many animals warm in cold weather.

flyers-furry.hint: A furry rabbit feels soft when you stroke it.
flyers-furry.fact: Furry animals often feel warm and soft to touch.

flyers-future.definition: the time that has not happened yet
flyers-future.hint: Talk about what you want to do when you grow up.
